citations.citation: Kosakovsky Pond SL, Frost SDW (2005). Not So Different After All: A Comparison of Methods for Detecting Amino Acid Sites Under Selection. Mol Biol Evol 22(5): 1208-1222.

analysis.description: FEL (Fixed Effects Likelihood) estimates site-wise synonymous (alpha) and non-synonymous (beta) rates, and uses a likelihood ratio test to determine if beta != alpha at a site.
analysis.name: Fixed Effects Likelihood

codon_mg94.description: Muse-Gaut 1994 x GTR codon model with shared global omega

nucleotide_gtr.description: General Time Reversible nucleotide model with empirical frequencies

beta.description: Non-synonymous substitution rate estimate on tested branches (beta)

classification.description: Selection classification at threshold (diversifying, purifying, neutral)

lrt.description: Likelihood ratio test statistic for beta != alpha

mean_substitution_branch_length.description: Mean length of branches where substitutions occurred at this site

mean_substitution_surprise.description: Mean Shannon self-information (-log2 P) of substitutions at this site

nonsynonymous_substitutions.description: Count of non-synonymous substitutions on tested branches

substitution_history.description: Formatted substitution history summary (AA changes, hit counts, surprise)

synonymous_substitutions.description: Count of synonymous substitutions on tested branches

total_branch_length.description: Total length of tested branches contributing to inference at this site
